1.Na3 e5 2.Nc4 Nc6 3.e4.strategy: Claims the centre with a pawn and opens lines for the queen and the f1-bishop. White has repaired the opening with the knight on c4, and the tempo spent on the knight's trip is the price for a normal, open game.

1.Na3 e5 2.Nc4 Nc6 3.e4 f5.strategy: Challenges the e4 pawn at once and tries to take the initiative, but weakens the king: the diagonal to e8 is open. A sharp, unbalanced game results, in which White can choose to open lines and punish the loosened position.
1.Na3 e5 2.Nc4 Nc6 3.e4 f5.name: Durkin Opening: Durkin Gambit
